content.text: Image point coordinates are in [y, x] format, where y is the vertical axis, x is the horizontal axis; their values are normalized from 0 to 1000, where [0 0] is the top left, [1000 1000] is the bottom right. What object is located right above point [4 436] in the second image, just out of the frame?  Choices: A. shoes. B. TV screen. C. hook. D. window. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
